top_signals.title: How an 800-year-old date still controls modern office leases – and why flexible space sidesteps it  entirely
top_signals.summary: Queen Elizabeth I was feasting on roast goose on Michaelmas Day in 1588 when she first heard of Britain’s victory over the Spanish Armada. While the roast bird had already become popular fare to mark the Christian celebration – also known as the Feast of the Archangels – her celebratory meal cemented it as tradition. [...]
